title: Compact Cluster Network Health & Cost Insights: compact dashboard prototype for Private/VPC clusters
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact cluster-level dashboard card that surfaces networking health, upgrade status, and per-cluster cost insights for Private/VPC deployments. The card should be usable on the cluster listing page and in a cluster detail header; it must be compact, scannable, and actionable with RBAC-aware quick actions (drain, drain-and-upgrade, open network debug).
background: Teams running Redwood Private want a single glance view that shows whether a cluster's network configuration and connectivity are healthy, whether any nodes are mid-upgrade, and a lightweight cost estimate for that cluster. Current console pages are large and siloed (separate network topology, cluster status, and cost pages). This ticket aims to consolidate key signals into a single compact UI card to reduce context switching.
goals: Create a compact card (desktop and wide tablet) that fits on cluster list rows and on cluster overview header
Surface three primary signals: Network Health, Upgrade Status, Estimated 24h Cost
Provide two contextual quick actions with permission gating: Open Network Debug, Start Cluster Upgrade (canary)
Ensure data freshness indicators and fallback states for disconnected control planes
Prototype interactions for inline rollouts status and cost breakdown hover
non_goals: Replace full topology canvas or deep cost reports
Implement full RBAC backend (this ticket is design + front-end prototype; engineering will wire auth)
proposed_components: Compact card layout (left: 48px cluster badge + name; center: three horizontal mini-tiles; right: quick actions)
Network Health mini-tile: color-coded band + micro-sparkline for packet loss/latency
Upgrade Status mini-tile: small progress bar + textual state (Idle / Canary / Rolling / Failed)
Cost mini-tile: estimated 24h USD + percent change vs baseline
Hover panel: expanded cost breakdown and last 5 rollout events
AR/AT (accessibility) labels for all status indicators and tooltips
usability_notes: Prefer short numeric values (e.g., 12ms / 0.03% packet loss) with tooltips for trend context
Default to aggregated cluster-level health; allow drill into node list from hover
When control plane unreachable show 'stale' badge and last-seen timestamp
Test compact card at 820px width (cluster list) and 1280px (cluster header)
engineering_feedback: ENG review 2026-03-02: backend must expose node-level latency histogram and a cluster-level aggregate to avoid per-cluster O(N) calls
ENG note: cost estimate should be computed server-side and cached for 5 minutes to keep API load reasonable
Infra concern: network health metrics rely on synthetic probes that currently run every 30s; consider adding last_probe_age field
Security: quick actions must call endpoints that validate RBAC and MFA status for destructive ops
design_decisions: Use 3-tile layout to maximize scannability and reuse on list and detail pages
Color semantics: green/yellow/red with accessibility-contrast-checked icons (not color-only), and numeric text
Show cost as a lightweight estimate (rounded) with a hover showing amplification factors (gpu-hours, storage)
Keep topology link separate from card to avoid rendering heavy canvases in list views
risks: Misleading cost estimates if customers have custom billing adjustments; include 'estimate' label prominently
Premature exposure of sensitive network metadata; omit IP-level details in list view
Overloading the card with metrics causes cognitive noise; prioritize three primary signals
